title: Two-thirds error threshold for randomized time
statement: For every time bound $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the class of languages decidable by a randomized machine in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$, with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members and rejection probability at least $2/3$ on nonmembers, equals the corresponding class defined using the fixed success threshold $2/3$.
